messages:
alex: Heads-up: rolling out service-edge v2.3.1 to prod in the 23:00-00:00 change window. Canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 5m steps. Please watch SLOs (p95 lat, errors) and flag anything unusual. I'll trigger ramp at :58. @maya @juan

deploy-bot: deploy started: service-edge v2.3.1 — canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% | runbook: /runbooks/deploys#service-edge | link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/ops/1937654321 :rocket:

maya: Noted. Opening dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/slo/service-edge. Keeping an eye on p95 and 5xx rate.

monitoring-bot: ALERT: service-edge p95 latency > 600ms (canary) — 3m rolling avg — triggered 1937654335. Graph: https://alerts.redwood/internal/alerts/5412 :warning:

juan: I see the spike on the canary nodes (gpu-12, gpu-13). Logs show repeated 'kv_cache_miss' errors. Pasting last lines: ```[2026-03-20T23:58:10Z] ERROR kvcache: miss id=0x9a3 node=gpu-12 model=redwood-qlora seq=2048```

priya: @alex can we hold the ramp at 10%? I'm seeing 2x error-rate vs baseline. Suggest pausing and running smoke tests.

alex: Pausing ramp. @deploy-bot hold-ramp 1937654321 -> acknowledged

deploy-bot: Ramp paused by alex. current_traffic=10% canary_state=paused

maya: Running quick smoke: `curl -s -X POST https://service-edge.prod/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $PROD_TOKEN' -o /tmp/smoke.json && jq .status /tmp/smoke.json` -> returned `ok` on control node but failing on gpu-12.

juan: Repro: SSH to gpu-12 shows nvml errors and high memory churn. `nvidia-smi` snippet: ```+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | GPU-12 | Memory-Error: ECC Uncorrectable | Util 99% | Temp 85C |``` Might be thermal or driver regression.

priya: Can we pin the old model on the affected node or route canary off those hosts? Options: 1) pin to v2.3.0 2) exclude gpu-12/gpu-13 from canary 3) rollback entire canary. My vote: exclude hosts and recheck.

alex: Exclude hosts for now. @infra-team can we add an autoscaling/host-exclusion tag to canary? @deploy-bot set-exclusion gpu-12,gpu-13

infra-bot: hosts excluded: gpu-12,gpu-13 from canary pool. Canary traffic redistributed across gpu-14,gpu-15.

monitoring-bot: INFO: 30s after exclusion p95 back to 210ms, 5xx rate dropped to baseline. No new alerts. (1937654370)

maya: :thumbsup: Re-running smoke suite across canary nodes. All smoke tests passing now.

alex: Good catch. We'll continue the ramp after 10m observation window. Will monitor SLOs and escalate if alert recurs. Adding note to release notes: 'paused ramp due to node-level hardware errors; excluded affected hosts; resumed canary after stabilization.'

priya: :white_check_mark: I'll update the rollback doc and mark the incident for postmortem if trend repeats.
